prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Houston for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right one depends on your location, budget, age (child vs. adult), desired treatment (traditional braces vs. Invisalign), insurance, and personal preferences. I can help you find the best option near you. To get you started:

How to find top orthodontists in Houston
- Use reputable directories:
  - American Association of Orthodontists (AAO) “Find an Orthodontist”
  - Invisalign Provider Locator (shows provider experience level: Preferred, Platinum, Diamond, etc.)
  - Google Reviews, Yelp, Healthgrades for patient feedback and before/after photos
- Verify credentials:
  - Make sure the clinician is an orthodontist (completed a residency after dental school), not just a general dentist offering braces/Invisalign
  - Check for American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) certification — a good sign of advanced training and commitment

What to look for
- Experience with your treatment: many Invisalign “Diamond”/“Platinum” providers have treated hundreds or thousands of cases
- Technology: iTero 3D scans, CBCT when needed, digital treatment planning
- Before/after photos of cases similar to yours (adult crowding, bite correction, gaps, etc.)
- Clear pricing, payment plans, and insurance handling
- Communication and follow-up (how emergencies are handled, appointment availability)
- Comfortable office location/hours and staff you get along with

Questions to ask at a consult
- Are you an orthodontist (not a general dentist)? Are you board-certified?
- How many cases like mine have you treated with braces/Invisalign?
- What results can I reasonably expect, and do you have before/after photos?
- How long will treatment take? What is the cost and what’s included?
- Do you offer financing or accept my insurance?
- What happens if I break a bracket or lose an aligner? How often are follow-ups?

Typical cost ranges (Houston / U.S. general)
- Invisalign: roughly $3,000–$8,000 depending on complexity
- Traditional braces: roughly $3,000–$7,000
(These are ballpark ranges — get office estimates.)

If you want, I can:
- Look up highly rated orthodontists near your address or zip code
- Compare 3–5 top offices (reviews, Invisalign status, board certification)
Tell me your zip code/neighborhood, whether the patient is an adult or child, and any budget or insurance constraints — I’ll find specific local options.
